description: This file defines the MPSImageWrapper class, which provides an interface for managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) images, including data transfer, storage allocation, and command buffer management within the PyTorch framework's Metal backend.

classes.name: MPSImageWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Metal Performance Shaders image objects for seamless integration with PyTorch's Metal backend, managing resource allocation, data transfer, and synchronization.

methods.name: MPSImageWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with specified image sizes.

methods.name: copyDataFromHost
methods.description: Copies data from CPU host memory into the GPU image.

methods.name: copyDataToHost
methods.description: Copies data from the GPU image to CPU host memory.

methods.name: allocateStorage
methods.description: Allocates GPU storage for the image based on sizes.

methods.name: allocateTemporaryStorage
methods.description: Allocates temporary GPU storage for intermediate computations.

methods.name: setCommandBuffer
methods.description: Associates a command buffer with the image for GPU operations.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Returns the Metal buffer associated with the image.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the image data between GPU and CPU.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the image for GPU operations.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the image.
